$comment: Mock Jira-style tickets. Used in the optional internal-tool stretch (Track C Part 3 — feedback → Jira pipeline).

tickets.title: PDF export times out on invoices with 50+ line items
tickets.description: Users report 30-60 second waits when generating PDFs for large invoices. Likely related to the pdfkit migration.

tickets.title: Add Google + Microsoft SSO
tickets.description: Enterprise prospects keep asking. Estimate is unclear — depends on auth refactor.

tickets.title: Currency formatting inconsistent across invoice list and dashboard
tickets.description: Dashboard always shows USD. Invoice list shows code prefix. PDF varies. Needs consolidation to lib/currency.ts.

tickets.title: Recurring invoices
tickets.description: Highest-voted feature request. Should support monthly, quarterly, annual cadences.

tickets.title: CSV export for invoices
tickets.description: Users want to export invoice data for accounting tools. Typical shape: invoice number, customer, date, total, status.

tickets.title: Mobile app freeze on invoice creation
tickets.description: iPhone 13 Pro freezes when adding 5+ line items. Reproducible.

tickets.title: Customer search/filter on /customers page
tickets.description: Once a user has 50+ customers the page becomes hard to navigate. Add a search box.

tickets.title: Hebrew RTL support
tickets.description: Israeli users have asked. Includes both UI mirroring and number/date formatting.

tickets.title: Invoice templates (custom branding)
tickets.description: Let users upload a logo and customize colors for the PDF output. Tied to BETA_PDF_EXPORT migration.

tickets.title: Stripe Connect integration
tickets.description: Let customers pay invoices directly via a hosted Stripe checkout. Often requested by Pro users.
